messages.text: This was a replacement I came home today to a vreg overheat guru error
I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Let me check a couple of things on that error before I answer.
Searched the web · NerdOctaxe "VREG" overheat error ESP-Miner

I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Sorry you walked into that.

What that error means: the firmware watches the voltage regulator (VRM) temperature, and if it reads out of range the moment the ASIC voltage is switched on, it cuts the ASIC voltage to 0V and parks the unit on that screen. 
On the NerdQAxe/Octaxe firmware it shows as "VREG Overheated Guru Meditation #····", with the voltage forced back to 0.000V about 20ms after enable
. That is from the ESP-Miner NerdQAxePlus issue tracker on GitHub, not from memory.

Two things from you, then I can settle it:

1. Full cold power cycle: unplug the DC barrel from the unit, unplug the brick from the wall, wait 60 seconds, plug back in. Does it boot and hash, or come straight back to the same screen?
2. A photo of the screen showing the error, and a photo of the serial label on the back.

While it is sitting on that screen it is not hashing, so leave it unplugged if you prefer until we know more. If it ever smells hot or the plug gets warm, unplug it and tell me straight away.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)
Verdict recorded and handed back to support.
